integrity: The proof is self-contained. Direct original-equation checks exhaust all nonzero factor pairs at matrix size two over fields of orders 2, 3, 4; size-three checks over the field of order 2 exhaust reduced conditions and directly check all admitted pairs. These checks corroborate rather than establish the arbitrary-field theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only decomposable-or-zero constant associative Yang–Baxter tensors on full matrix algebras and the corresponding elementary two-sided multipliers are classified; all-size counts require finite fields. No scheme, orbit, or general-tensor classification is asserted; publication priority remains provisional.
title: Decomposable associative Yang–Baxter tensors: square-zero rigidity and exact elementary-operator rank spectra
